para: Using a ConditionalOutputSchedule as the scheduledtype argument in means that the times produced by the are determined on-the-fly by the object. The ConditionalOutputSchedule doesn't do anything except to state that the is neither absolute nor relative.

In principle, conditional outputs could be produced when the &fields; or &fluxes; meet some criterion, or when an error estimate is within some bounds. At the current time, however, there is only one conditional , , and its conditional nature is suspect.
